description: Comprehensive Actual Budget Financial Intelligence Dashboard powered by SQLite. Features Liquidity Runway, Spend Velocity curves, Z-Score Outlier Radar, 80/20 Pareto Merchant Analytics, 30/60/90-Day Projections, and Layman's Explanations for all metrics.

panels.title: 1. Executive Financial Health & Liquidity Runway
📖 Layman's Guide: Executive Financial Health & Runway

options.content:
### 💡 How to Read Your Executive Financial Health Metrics

* **Total Net Worth**: *"What is your overall wealth across all assets and debts?"* Sum of all real estate home equity, 401(k), brokerage, IRAs, and bank balances minus all loans and credit cards.
* **Liquid Cash in Hand**: *"How much cash could you deploy right now without selling investments or touching retirement?"* Sums checking, high-yield savings, and cash minus current credit card float.
* **Dynamic Runway Scenarios (Months)**:
  * **Worst-Case: If Both Lose Jobs (Zero Income)**: *"If both Jacob and Priyanka lose all income today, how many months can combined liquid reserves cover full household living expenses with $0 coming in?"* 🟢 **>6 months** = Safe emergency cushion.
  * **If Priyanka Loses Job (Jacob Working)**: *"If Priyanka's income stops while Jacob continues working, how many months will liquid cash reserves last to cover the net household living shortfall?"* 🟢 **>24 months** = Robust security moat.
  * **If Jacob Loses Job (Priyanka Working)**: *"If Jacob's income stops while Priyanka continues working, how many months will liquid cash reserves last to cover the net household living shortfall?"* 🟢 **>12 months** = Safe cushion.
* **Monthly Savings & Wealth Rate (Trailing 30D — All 3 Forms, Data-Anchored to Latest Synced Transaction)**:
  1. **Post-Tax Take-Home (`~36%`)**: `(Net Pay - (Net Core Living + House Equity Principal)) / Net Pay` — how much of your checking take-home pay is retained after paying all living bills and the full mortgage.
  2. **All-In Invest + Cash (`~47%`)**: `((Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA) - (Net Core Living + House Equity Principal)) / (Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA)` — includes your pre-tax 401(k) & HSA payroll contributions (`~$1,978/mo`) alongside your `$3,000/mo` brokerage autodraft while still treating the full mortgage as a housing expense.
  3. **Total Wealth-Building (`~59%`)**: `((Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA) - Net Core Living Excl. Principal) / (Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA)` — includes pre-tax 401(k)/HSA, taxable brokerage, cash savings, **and** your `~$1,400/mo` `House Equity` mortgage principal buildup.
* **Asset Allocation**: Distribution of your total wealth between Real Estate Equity (net of mortgage), Retirement (401k/IRA/HSA), Taxable Brokerage, Vehicle Equity (Tacoma + VW GTI net of South State car loan), and Liquid Cash Reserves (net of credit card float).
* **Global Account Directory**: Authoritative classification matrix of all 34+ household accounts with live balances, balance sheet side, ownership, and segregation of paid-off/closed accounts.
* **Needs vs Wants (50/30/20 Rule)**: Non-discretionary survival bills (housing, utilities, groceries, insurance) should stay under **50–60%** of living expenses. Discretionary (restaurants, entertainment, shopping) is your buffer to cut in tough months.
* **Monthly & Yearly Actual Spend (Core Living vs. Amortized Total vs. Excl. Mortgage / FIRE)**:
  * **Core Living Spend (Panels 113 & 115)**: True net household cash-flow spend (`Expected` + `Fun` + uncategorized outflows + full `$3,627.56/mo` mortgage obligation including `~$1,400/mo` `House Equity` principal paydown). Strictly excludes cross-account transfers, savings/brokerage allocations, the `$106.6k` house downpayment transfer, and one-off capital purchases, while netting out merchant returns, tax rebates, and roommate/family reimbursements.
  * **Amortized Total Spend (Panels 114 & 116)**: Adds irregular `One-Time` lifestyle spend (`Weddings`, `Door Locks`, `Laptop`, etc.) plus straight-line amortized slices of major capital assets over their useful lives (`Truck` `$34,632` net cash check over 84 mos / 7 yrs = `+$412/mo` or `+$4,947/yr`; `House Purchase` net closing/EMD/move-in `$10,989` over 120 mos / 10 yrs = `+$92/mo` or `+$1,099/yr`; `Ring [J]` `$5,950` over 120 mos / 10 yrs = `+$50/mo` or `+$595/yr`).
  * **Yearly Spend Excl. Mortgage — Paid-Off Home / Early-Retirement FIRE Baseline (Panel 117)**: Strips out your `$3,627.56/mo` (`$43,530.72/yr`) `Rocket Mortgage` payment (and prior `Belmont on Broad` / `KPM LLC` apartment rent) while **retaining all home utilities** (`Dominion Energy` electricity, `Verizon` internet, `Henrico County` water/trash) and all lifestyle categories (`Groceries`, `Dog`, `Gas`, `Bills`/insurance, `Fun`, `Subscriptions`). Shows three views: **Lifestyle Run-Rate (`~$36.9k/yr` = `$3,071/mo`)**, **TTM Lifestyle (`~$40.4k/yr` = `$3,368/mo`)**, and **FIRE w/ Amortized CapEx (`~$45.8k/yr` = `$3,818/mo`, adding amortized vehicle & one-time expenses)**. *(Note: If you add back `~$5.1k/yr` for unescrowed property tax & homeowners insurance on a paid-off home, your all-in paid-off-home cost of living is `~$42.0k/yr` core or `~$50.9k/yr` with vehicle/CapEx amortization — requiring a `~$1.05M–$1.27M` portfolio at a 4% safe withdrawal rate.)*

panels.title: Total Net Worth (Full Balance Sheet)
panels.description:
Plain English: Your entire financial net worth: sum of all cash, home equity, 401(k), brokerage, and retirement accounts minus all loans and credit card float.

Formula: Total Net Worth = SUM(All Open Asset Accounts) - SUM(All Liabilities)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)), 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS "Total Net Worth"
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.tombstone = 0
  AND a.closed = 0

panels.title: Liquid Cash in Hand (Deployable Reserves)
panels.description:
Plain English: How much cash you can instantly deploy right now without selling investments or touching retirement lockups. Sourced directly from live bank-synced account balances across all on-budget accounts (checking, credit card float) plus the off-budget joint savings account.

Formula: Liquid Cash = SUM(Current Balance of On-Budget Accounts + Savings Joint)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)), 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS "Liquid Cash in Hand"
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.tombstone = 0
  AND a.closed = 0
  AND (a.offbudget = 0 OR a.name = 'Savings Joint')

panels.title: Dynamic Runway: If Both Lose Jobs (Worst-Case Buffer)
panels.description:
Plain English: If both Jacob and Priyanka were to lose all household income today, how many months can you cover your full living overhead (housing, groceries, utilities, bills, pets) before running out of liquid cash reserves with $0.00 coming in?

Thresholds: 🟢 >6 months is safe emergency cushion, 🟡 3–6 months is cautious, 🔴 <3 months is emergency mode.

Formula: Runway (Months) = Liquid Cash / Trailing 90-Day Monthly Operating Living Burn

Note: Cleanly excludes internal savings transfers, investment contributions, and paid-off/closed accounts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH liquid AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)), 0)) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND (a.offbudget = 0 OR a.name = 'Savings Joint')
),
operating_burn AS (
  SELECT MAX(1.0, ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0 / 3.0) AS monthly_burn
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(liquid.bal / operating_burn.monthly_burn, 1) AS "Runway (Months)"
FROM liquid, operating_burn

panels.title: Dynamic Runway: If Priyanka Loses Job (Jacob Working)
panels.description:
Plain English: If Priyanka's income were to stop today while Jacob's income continues uninterrupted, how many months will liquid cash reserves last to cover the net household living shortfall?

Thresholds: 🟢 >24 months is a massive security moat, 🟡 12–24 months is healthy cushion, 🔴 <12 months is tight margin.

Formula: Liquid Cash / MAX(0.01, Trailing 90-Day Living Burn - Jacob's Monthly Income)

targets.rawSql:
WITH liquid AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t WHERE t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)), 0)) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND (a.offbudget = 0 OR a.name = 'Savings Joint')
),
operating_burn AS (
  SELECT MAX(1.0, ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0 / 3.0) AS monthly_burn
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER)
),
incomes AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%[J]%' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 / 3.0, 0.0) AS j_income
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND c.is_income = 1
    AND t.amount > 0
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN operating_burn.monthly_burn - incomes.j_income <= 0 THEN 120.0
    ELSE ROUND(liquid.bal / (operating_burn.monthly_burn - incomes.j_income), 1)
  END AS "Runway (Months)"
FROM liquid, operating_burn, incomes

    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER)
),
incomes AS (

FROM liquid, operating_burn, incomes

panels.title: Monthly Savings & Wealth Rate (T-30D: All 3 Forms)
panels.description:
Plain English: Out of every dollar earned over the trailing 30 days of synced transactions, how many cents stay in your pocket across all 3 personal finance definitions:
1. Post-Tax Take-Home (~36.1%): (Net Pay - (Net Core Living + House Equity Principal)) / Net Pay
2. All-In Invest + Cash (~46.6%): ((Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA) - (Net Core Living + House Equity Principal)) / (Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA)
3. Total Wealth-Building (~58.6%): ((Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA) - Net Core Living Excl. Principal) / (Net Pay + Pre-Tax 401k/HSA)

Thresholds: 🟢 ≥25% is strong wealth accumulation, 🟡 10–25% is moderate, 🔴 <10% is tight.

Note: Anchored to MAX(transactions.date) so an unsynced bank import gap never chops off a biweekly paycheck cycle while retaining the monthly mortgage payment.

targets.rawSql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' ||
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' ||
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)
    ),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions
  WHERE tombstone = 0
),
t30 AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.is_income = 1 AND t.amount > 0 AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
      THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0, 0.0) AS net_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN (a.name = 'C1 401k [J]' AND p.name = 'Contribution' AND t.amount > 0)
        OR (a.name = 'HSA [J]' AND p.name IN ('Employee Contribution', 'Employer Contribution') AND t.amount > 0)
      THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0, 0.0) AS explicit_pretax_contrib,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.is_income = 1 AND c.name = 'Income [J]' AND t.amount >= 200000 AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 989.07, 0.0) AS payroll_implied_pretax,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
        AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
        AND g.name IN ('Expected', 'Fun')
      THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0, 0.0) AS core_living_excl_principal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'House Equity' AND t.amount < 0
      THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0, 0.0) AS house_equity_principal
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-29 day')) AS INTEGER)
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    net_income,
    MAX(explicit_pretax_contrib, payroll_implied_pretax) AS pretax_contrib,
    core_living_excl_principal,
    house_equity_principal,
    net_income + MAX(explicit_pretax_contrib, payroll_implied_pretax) AS total_investable_income,
    core_living_excl_principal + house_equity_principal AS total_core_living
  FROM t30
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN net_income <= 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE ROUND(((net_income - total_core_living) / net_income) * 100.0, 1)
  END AS "Post-Tax Take-Home",
  CASE WHEN total_investable_income <= 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE ROUND(((total_investable_income - total_core_living) / total_investable_income) * 100.0, 1)
  END AS "All-In Invest + Cash",
  CASE WHEN total_investable_income <= 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE ROUND(((total_investable_income - core_living_excl_principal) / total_investable_income) * 100.0, 1)
  END AS "Total Wealth-Building"
FROM calc

panels.title: Monthly Spend: Core Living (Excl. CapEx)
panels.description:
Plain English: Your true recurring monthly household cash-flow spend (Trailing 90-Day Monthly Average vs. Current Month-to-Date).

What is INCLUDED:
- Expected & Fun categories (Net of merchant returns, tax rebates, and roommate/family reimbursements)
- Full $3,627.56/mo Rocket Mortgage payment (~$2,250/mo Housing interest/escrow + ~$1,400/mo House Equity principal paydown)
- Uncategorized non-transfer outflows

What is EXCLUDED:
- Cross-account transfers, credit card payments, savings/brokerage allocations, $106.6k house downpayment transfer, and One-Time capital purchases (Truck, House Purchase closing/move-in, Ring).

WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' ||
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' ||
      substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)
    ),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions
  WHERE tombstone = 0
),
base_tx AS (
  SELECT
    t.date,
    t.amount / 100.0 AS amt,
    t.category,
    c.name AS cat_name,
    g.name AS grp_name,
    t.transferred_id,
    p.transfer_acct
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', (SELECT max_dt FROM anchor)) AS INTEGER)
       AND (
         (grp_name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND transferred_id IS NULL AND (transfer_acct IS NULL OR transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (category IS NULL AND transferred_id IS NULL AND (transfer_acct IS NULL OR transfer_acct = '') AND amt < 0)
         OR (cat_name = 'House Equity' AND amt < 0)
       )
      THEN -amt ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS mtd_core_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-89 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND (
         (grp_name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND transferred_id IS NULL AND (transfer_acct IS NULL OR transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (category IS NULL AND transferred_id IS NULL AND (transfer_acct IS NULL OR transfer_acct = '') AND amt < 0)
         OR (cat_name = 'House Equity' AND amt < 0)
       )
      THEN -amt ELSE 0.0 END) / 3.0, 0.0) AS t90_monthly_core_net
  FROM base_tx
)
SELECT
  ROUND(t90_monthly_core_net, 2) AS "T-90D Avg (/mo)",
  ROUND(mtd_core_net, 2) AS "Current MTD"
FROM metrics

panels.title: Monthly Spend: Amortized Total (Incl. CapEx)
panels.description:
Plain English: Your all-in monthly spend when irregular lifestyle purchases and big-ticket capital assets are smoothed over their useful lives.

Amortization Breakdown (~$838/mo add-on above Core Living):
- Truck ($34,632.24 net check amortized over 84 mos / 7 yrs): +$412.29/mo
- House Purchase Closing, EMD & Move-In ($10,988.57 net of closing refund & gifts, amortized over 120 mos / 10 yrs): +$91.57/mo
- Engagement/Wedding Ring ($5,949.71 amortized over 120 mos / 10 yrs): +$49.58/mo
- Irregular One-Time Lifestyle (Weddings, Door Locks, Laptop, etc. T-12M net avg): +$284.10/mo

Note: $106,635.66 house downpayment is a balance-sheet asset conversion (Savings -> Home Equity) and is excluded.

      THEN -amt ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ttm_onetime_lifestyle_net,

panels.title: Yearly Spend: Excl. Mortgage (Paid-Off Home / FIRE)
panels.description:
Plain English: Your annual cost of living if your home were paid off and you retired early (excludes your $3,627.56/mo = $43,530.72/yr Rocket Mortgage payment and prior Belmont on Broad / KPM LLC apartment rent, while keeping all home utilities like Dominion Energy electricity, Verizon internet, and Henrico County water/trash):
1. Lifestyle Run-Rate (~$36.9k/yr = $3,071/mo): Annualized T-90D core lifestyle & utility spend without mortgage/rent.
2. TTM Lifestyle (~$40.4k/yr = $3,368/mo): Trailing 12-month actual core lifestyle & utility spend without mortgage/rent.
3. FIRE w/ Amort CapEx (~$45.8k/yr = $3,818/mo): Adds ongoing amortized vehicle replacement (Truck +$4,947/yr) & irregular One-Time lifestyle events (+$3,409/yr + Ring +$595/yr).

Note: If you add back ~$5,121/yr (~$427/mo) for unescrowed property taxes & homeowners insurance on a paid-off home, your paid-off-home cost of living is ~$42.0k/yr (Core) or ~$50.9k/yr (with CapEx) — requiring ~$1.05M to ~$1.27M invested at a 4% Safe Withdrawal Rate.

panels.title: Asset Class Allocation (Full Balance Sheet)
panels.description:
Plain English: How your entire net worth is distributed across primary asset classes: Real Estate Equity (House minus Mortgage), Retirement & Tax-Advantaged (401k, IRAs, HSA), Taxable Brokerage Investments, Vehicle Equity (Tacoma + VW GTI minus South State auto loan), and Liquid Cash Reserves (net of credit card float).

Formula: SUM(Open Asset Balances) grouped by Asset Class

Action: Maintain a balanced asset portfolio aligned with long-term financial independence goals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%Equity%' OR a.name = 'House' OR a.name = 'Mortgage' THEN '🏡 Real Estate Equity'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%401k%' OR a.name LIKE '%IRA%' OR a.name LIKE '%Ret Plan%' OR a.name LIKE '%Savings Plan%' OR a.name LIKE '%HSA%' THEN '📈 Retirement & Tax-Advantaged'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%Brokerage%' OR a.name LIKE '%Stock%' THEN '📊 Taxable Investments'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%Tacoma%' OR a.name LIKE '%GTI%' OR a.name LIKE '%Vehicle%' OR a.name LIKE '%Auto%' OR a.name LIKE '%South State Loan%' THEN '🚗 Vehicle Equity'
    WHEN a.offbudget = 0 OR a.name = 'Savings Joint' THEN '💵 Liquid Cash & Bank Reserves'
    ELSE '📦 Other Assets'
  END AS "Asset Class",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, (SELECT SUM(t2.amount) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.acct = a.id AND t2.tombstone = 0 AND (t2.isParent IS NULL OR t2.isParent = 0)), 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS "Balance ($)"
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.tombstone = 0
  AND a.closed = 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING "Balance ($)" > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 50/30/20 Rule: Full Income & Budget Allocation
panels.description:
Plain English: Macro-allocation of your total monthly cash flow across the gold standard 50/30/20 personal finance framework:
1. 💰 Wealth Building & Savings (Benchmark: ≥ 20%): Direct investments, brokerage contributions, house equity principal, and savings
2. 🛡️ Core Living Overhead (Benchmark: ≤ 50%): Essential overhead (housing, utilities, groceries, transportation, bills, pet care)
3. 🎯 Discretionary & Lifestyle (Benchmark: ≤ 30%): Fun money, dining out, recreation, and personal lifestyle
4. 🏛️ Taxes & Sinking Funds: Segregated statutory obligations and one-time reserves

Formula: Monthly Budgeted Allocation by 50/30/20 Personal Finance Pillar

Action: Keep core overhead below 50% and maximize wealth velocity above 20%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN g.name = 'Investments and Savings' THEN '💰 Wealth Building & Savings'
    WHEN c.name LIKE '%Tax%' OR g.name LIKE '%Tax%' OR g.name = 'One-Time' THEN '🏛️ Taxes & Sinking Funds'
    WHEN c.name IN ('Housing', 'Groceries', 'Food', 'Bills', 'Bills [J]', 'Bills [P]', 'Gas', 'Gas [J]', 'Gas [P]', 'Car Maintenance', 'Car Maintenance [J]', 'Car Maintenance [P]', 'Work Lunch', 'Work Lunch [J]', 'Work Lunch [P]', 'Dog')
         OR g.name IN ('Bills', 'Utilities', 'Housing', 'Debt', 'Essential', 'Fixed') THEN '🛡️ Core Living Needs'
    ELSE '🎯 Discretionary & Lifestyle'
  END AS "Budget Pillar",
  ROUND(SUM(b.amount) / 100.0, 2) AS "Amount ($)"
FROM zero_budgets b
JOIN categories c ON b.category = c.id
JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
WHERE b.month = CAST(strftime('%Y%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
  AND b.amount > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Needs vs. Wants: Trailing 30-Day Living Expense Split
panels.description:
Plain English: 3-way breakdown of your trailing 30-day operating spend across:
1. 🛡️ Core Living Needs: Essential survival overhead (housing, utilities/bills, groceries, dog care, transportation)
2. 🎯 Discretionary (Wants): Lifestyle & fun choices (dining, entertainment, shopping, subscriptions)
3. 🏛️ Taxes & Statutory: Non-controllable obligations (personal property taxes, tax prep/settlements)

Note: Slices your living outlays only; cleanly excludes internal account transfers, brokerage/equity investments, and one-off capital purchases.

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.name LIKE '%Tax%' OR g.name LIKE '%Tax%' THEN '🏛️ Taxes & Statutory'
    WHEN c.name IN ('Housing', 'Groceries', 'Food', 'Bills', 'Bills [J]', 'Bills [P]', 'Gas', 'Gas [J]', 'Gas [P]', 'Car Maintenance', 'Car Maintenance [J]', 'Car Maintenance [P]', 'Work Lunch', 'Work Lunch [J]', 'Work Lunch [P]', 'Dog')
         OR g.name IN ('Bills', 'Utilities', 'Housing', 'Debt', 'Essential', 'Fixed')
         THEN '🛡️ Core Living Needs'
    ELSE '🎯 Discretionary (Wants)'
  END AS "Expense Type",
  ROUND(ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0, 2) AS "Amount ($)"
FROM transactions t
JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
WHERE t.tombstone = 0
  AND a.tombstone = 0
  AND a.closed = 0
  AND a.offbudget = 0
  AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
  AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
  AND c.is_income = 0
  AND t.amount < 0
  AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
  AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date('now', '-30 day')) AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
