panels.title: 5. Predictive Forecasting & Balance Projections
📖 Layman's Guide: Cash Flow Forecast & Budget Exhaustion

options.content:
### 💡 How to Read Predictive Forecasts & Balance Projections

* **30/60/90-Day Liquidity Forecast**: *"A crystal ball for your checking account."*
  * By projecting your 90-day net cash flow (monthly income minus average monthly burn) into the future, this forecasts your projected checking account balance at +30, +60, and +90 days.
  * **Thresholds**: 🟢 **Safe Cushion (>$2,000)**. 🟡 **Tight Margin ($500–$2,000)**. 🔴 **Overdraft Danger (<$500)**.
  * **What to do**: If future balance drops into yellow or red, transfer buffer cash from savings now before scheduled bills land.
* **Category Exhaustion Forecaster**: *"The Gas Tank Gauge."*
  * If you keep spending money on dining out or groceries at your current daily pace, this tells you the **exact calendar day of the month your budget hits \$0.00**.
  * **What to do**: Slow down daily spending pace if your exhaustion day arrives before the 25th of the month.

panels.title: 30/60/90-Day Projected Checking Cash Flow
panels.description:
Plain English: A crystal ball for your checking account. By projecting recent monthly cash burn and income into the future, it shows your projected bank balance so you never bounce a check or get hit with an overdraft fee.

Thresholds:
- 🟢 Safe Cushion (> $2,000)
- 🟡 Tight Margin ($500 - $2,000)
- 🔴 Overdraft Danger (< $500)

Action: If the 30-day projection enters yellow or red, transfer cash from savings immediately.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr_bal AS (
  SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.balance_current, 0)) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
),
checking_flows AS (
  SELECT
    (ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN t.amount < 0 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 100.0) / 3.0 AS m_outflow,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN t.amount > 0 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) / 3.0 AS m_inflow
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND a.name LIKE '%Checking%'
    AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
  'Today (Net Checking Liquidity)' AS "Time Horizon",
  ROUND(bal, 2) AS "Projected Balance ($)",
  '🟢 Live Balance' AS "Status"
FROM curr_bal
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Next 30 Days' AS "Time Horizon",
  ROUND(bal + (m_inflow - m_outflow), 2) AS "Projected Balance ($)",
  CASE WHEN bal + (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 2000 THEN '🟢 Safe Cushion' WHEN bal + (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 500 THEN '🟡 Tight Margin' ELSE '🔴 Overdraft Danger' END AS "Status"
FROM curr_bal, checking_flows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Next 60 Days' AS "Time Horizon",
  ROUND(bal + 2 * (m_inflow - m_outflow), 2) AS "Projected Balance ($)",
  CASE WHEN bal + 2 * (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 2000 THEN '🟢 Safe Cushion' WHEN bal + 2 * (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 500 THEN '🟡 Tight Margin' ELSE '🔴 Overdraft Danger' END AS "Status"
FROM curr_bal, checking_flows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Next 90 Days' AS "Time Horizon",
  ROUND(bal + 3 * (m_inflow - m_outflow), 2) AS "Projected Balance ($)",
  CASE WHEN bal + 3 * (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 2000 THEN '🟢 Safe Cushion' WHEN bal + 3 * (m_inflow - m_outflow) > 500 THEN '🟡 Tight Margin' ELSE '🔴 Overdraft Danger' END AS "Status"
FROM curr_bal, checking_flows

panels.title: Category Budget Exhaustion Forecaster (The Gas Tank Gauge)
panels.description:
Plain English: The 'Gas Tank' gauge. If you keep spending money at your current daily rate, this tells you the exact calendar day of the month your category budget hits $0.00.

Formula: Exhaustion_Day = Spent_MTD / Daily_Burn + (Remaining_Buffer / Daily_Burn)

Action: If exhaustion date is earlier than month-end, throttle back daily spend in that category.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mtd_spend AS (
  SELECT
    t.category,
    ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0 AS spent,
    (ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0) / MAX(1, CAST(strftime('%d', 'now') AS INTEGER)) AS daily_burn
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
    AND substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 1, 6) = strftime('%Y%m', 'now')
  GROUP BY t.category
),
budget_limits AS (
  SELECT
    zb.category,
    zb.amount / 100.0 AS budget_limit
  FROM zero_budgets zb
  JOIN categories c ON zb.category = c.id
  JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  WHERE zb.month = CAST(strftime('%Y%m', 'now') AS INTEGER)
    AND zb.amount > 0
    AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings', 'One-Time')
),
days_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%d', 'now') AS REAL) AS current_day,
    CAST(strftime('%d', date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', 'now'), '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS REAL) AS days_in_month
)
SELECT
  c.name AS "Category",
  ROUND(b.budget_limit, 2) AS "Monthly Budget ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(m.spent, 0.0), 2) AS "Spent MTD ($)",
  ROUND(b.budget_limit - COALESCE(m.spent, 0.0), 2) AS "Remaining Buffer ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(m.daily_burn, 0.0), 2) AS "Daily Burn ($/day)",
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(m.spent, 0.0) >= b.budget_limit THEN '🚨 Over Budget'
    WHEN (COALESCE(m.daily_burn, 0.0) * d.days_in_month) > b.budget_limit THEN '🟡 Accelerating (Runs out Day ' || CAST(ROUND(b.budget_limit / MAX(0.01, m.daily_burn)) AS INT) || ')'
    ELSE '🟢 On Track (Pacing Well)'
  END AS "Burn Status Indicator"
FROM budget_limits b
JOIN categories c ON b.category = c.id
CROSS JOIN days_calc d
LEFT JOIN mtd_spend m ON b.category = m.category
ORDER BY (b.budget_limit - COALESCE(m.spent, 0.0)) ASC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: 6. Hierarchical Category Decomposition & Budget Variance
📖 Layman's Guide: Category Decomposition & Variance Scorecard

options.content:
### 💡 How to Read Category Decomposition & Budget Variance

* **Hierarchical Breakdown (Group $\rightarrow$ Category)**:
  * Visualizes where your money went over the last 30 days, grouping small line items under broad umbrellas (e.g. Housing, Food, Fun, Expected Bills).
* **Budget vs. Actual Variance Waterfall**: *"The scorecard at the end of the month: Did you beat your budget or blow it?"*
  * **Formula**: $\text{Net Variance} = \text{Budgeted} - \text{Actual Spend}$.
  * 🟢 **Surplus (Under Budget)**: Green blocks indicate categories where you spent less than budgeted, leaving positive cash.
  * 🔴 **Deficit (Over Budget)**: Red blocks indicate categories where you bled cash and exceeded budget limits.
  * **What to do**: Offset red deficits by transferring excess surplus from green categories before month close.

panels.title: Hierarchical Category Spend: Group -> Category
panels.description:
Plain English: Hierarchical categorical expense breakdown by Category Group -> Category -> Payee over the last 30 days.

Action: Identify top expense clusters within each category group to prioritize savings targets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  g.name AS "Category Group",
  c.name AS "Category",
  ROUND(ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0, 2) AS "Expense Amount ($)"
FROM transactions t
JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
WHERE t.tombstone = 0
  AND a.tombstone = 0
  AND a.closed = 0
  AND a.offbudget = 0
  AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
  AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
  AND c.is_income = 0
  AND t.amount < 0
  AND g.name NOT IN ('Investments and Savings')
  AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-30 day')) AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY g.name, c.name
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Budget vs. Actual Variance Waterfall (Monthly Scorecard)
panels.description:
Plain English: The scorecard at the end of the month: Did you beat your budget or blow it? Green blocks show categories where you saved money (surplus); red blocks show where you bled cash (deficit).

Formula: Net Variance = Budgeted - Actual Spend

Thresholds:
- 🟢 Surplus (Positive Variance): You beat your budget
- 🔴 Deficit (Negative Variance): You overspent

Action: Rebalance overspent categories with surplus savings from other groups.

targets.rawSql:
WITH budgeted AS (
  SELECT
    c.cat_group,
    SUM(zb.amount) / 100.0 AS budget_amt
  FROM zero_budgets zb
  JOIN categories c ON zb.category = c.id
  WHERE zb.month = CAST(strftime('%Y%m', 'now') AS INTEGER)
  GROUP BY c.cat_group
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT
    c.cat_group,
    ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0 AS actual_amt
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 1, 6) = strftime('%Y%m', 'now')
  GROUP BY c.cat_group
)
SELECT
  g.name AS "Category Group",
  ROUND(COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Budgeted ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Actual Spend ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0) - COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Net Variance ($)",
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0) - COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0) >= 0 THEN '🟢 Surplus (Under Budget)'
    ELSE '🔴 Deficit (Over Budget)'
  END AS "Budget Status"
FROM category_groups g
LEFT JOIN budgeted b ON g.id = b.cat_group
LEFT JOIN actuals a ON g.id = a.cat_group
WHERE g.tombstone = 0 AND g.is_income = 0
  AND (COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0) > 0)
ORDER BY "Net Variance ($)" ASC

    ABS(SUM(t.amount)) / 100.0 AS actual_amt
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0
    AND a.tombstone = 0
    AND a.closed = 0
    AND a.offbudget = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
    AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
    AND c.is_income = 0
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 1, 6) = strftime('%Y%m', 'now')
  GROUP BY c.cat_group
)
SELECT
  g.name AS "Category Group",
  ROUND(COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Budgeted ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Actual Spend ($)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0) - COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0), 2) AS "Net Variance ($)",
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0.0) - COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0.0) >= 0 THEN '🟢 Surplus (Under Budget)'
    ELSE '🔴 Deficit (Over Budget)'
  END AS "Budget Status"
FROM category_groups g
LEFT JOIN budgeted b ON g.id = b.cat_group
LEFT JOIN actuals a ON g.id = a.cat_group
WHERE g.tombstone = 0 AND g.is_income = 0
  AND (COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0) > 0)
ORDER BY "Net Variance ($)" ASC

panels.title: 7. Investment Portfolio & Brokerage Growth Intelligence (Ind Brokerage 6839 [J])
📖 Layman's Guide: Isolating True Market Growth from Auto-Deposits

options.content:
### 💡 How to Read Investment Growth & Capital Appreciation

* **Pure Market Growth (Excluding Deposits)**:
  * When you automatically transfer cash every week into your investment account, the total account balance climbs. But that **is not market profit** — that is just your own principal cash!
  * This suite filters out your weekly auto-deposits ($692.30/week) and isolates only the **reconciliation balance adjustments** (the market gains and dividend appreciation).
  * **Result**: You see your *real dollar growth and pure investment return* without artificial inflation from injecting money.
* **Moving Window Performance**:
  * Evaluates true market gains across rolling time horizons (Trailing 30-Day, 90-Day, 6-Month, 1-Year, and Inception).
* **Cost Basis vs. Total Value Wedge**:
  * Visualizes the compounding spread between your **Cumulative Injected Cash (Cost Basis)** and your **Live Account Value**.

panels.title: Brokerage Pure Capital Growth Curve (Excluding Deposits)
panels.description:
Plain English: Real investment growth curve over time, isolating pure stock market capital gains from weekly auto-deposits. Shows your exact cumulative dollar profit without artificial inflation from adding money.

Series:
- Cumulative Market Gain ($): Cumulative investment profit trajectory over time
- Periodic Reconciliation Gain ($): Individual market return captured at each reconciliation event.

Action: Track this trajectory to measure true market compounding.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw_events AS (
  SELECT
    t.date,
    CAST(strftime('%s', substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 7, 2)) AS INTEGER) AS time,
    t.amount / 100.0 AS gain_step
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  WHERE a.name LIKE '%Ind Brokerage 6839%'
    AND t.tombstone = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
    AND (t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%')
),
cum_events AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    gain_step,
    ROUND(SUM(gain_step) OVER (ORDER BY date ASC, time ASC), 2) AS cum_gain
  FROM raw_events
)
SELECT
  time,
  cum_gain AS "Cumulative Market Gain ($)",
  gain_step AS "Periodic Reconciliation Gain ($)"
FROM cum_events
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS time,
  (SELECT cum_gain FROM cum_events ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Cumulative Market Gain ($)",
  0.0 AS "Periodic Reconciliation Gain ($)"
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Moving Window Market Return & Pacing Scorecard
panels.description:
Plain English: Pure capital gains generated by the investment account across rolling time windows (Trailing 30 Days, 90 Days, 6 Months, 1 Year, and All-Time Inception), completely stripped of weekly deposit inflation.

Metrics:
- Pure Market Gain ($): Dollar growth earned in that window
- Return on Capital (%): Gain divided by total capital deployed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH gains AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS all_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-1 year')) AS INTEGER) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS t_1y,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-180 day')) AS INTEGER) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS t_6m,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-90 day')) AS INTEGER) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS t_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m01', date('now', '-30 day')) AS INTEGER) THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS t_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes IS NULL OR t.notes NOT LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND (t.imported_description IS NULL OR t.imported_description NOT LIKE '%Reconciliation%') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 AS total_deposits
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  WHERE a.name LIKE '%Ind Brokerage 6839%'
    AND t.tombstone = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
)
SELECT
  '1. Trailing 30 Days' AS "Time Window",
  ROUND(t_30d, 2) AS "Pure Market Gain ($)",
  ROUND((t_30d / MAX(1.0, total_deposits)) * 100.0, 1) AS "Return on Capital (%)",
  '🟢 Active Gain' AS "Pacing Status"
FROM gains
UNION ALL
SELECT '2. Trailing 90 Days', ROUND(t_90d, 2), ROUND((t_90d / MAX(1.0, total_deposits)) * 100.0, 1), '🟢 Active Gain' FROM gains
UNION ALL
SELECT '3. Trailing 6 Months', ROUND(t_6m, 2), ROUND((t_6m / MAX(1.0, total_deposits)) * 100.0, 1), '🟢 Robust Growth' FROM gains
UNION ALL
SELECT '4. Trailing 1 Year', ROUND(t_1y, 2), ROUND((t_1y / MAX(1.0, total_deposits)) * 100.0, 1), '🟢 Strong Compounding' FROM gains
UNION ALL
SELECT '5. All-Time Inception', ROUND(all_time, 2), ROUND((all_time / MAX(1.0, total_deposits)) * 100.0, 1), '🟢 Wealth Accumulation' FROM gains
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Total Portfolio Value vs. Cumulative Cash Injected (Cost Basis Gap)
panels.description:
Plain English: Compares your Total Account Value against your Cumulative Cash Contributions (Cost Basis). The widening gap between the curves represents your pure compounding profit wedge.

Series:
- Total Portfolio Value ($): Current balance over time
- Cumulative Cash Injected ($): Total cumulative cash put in.

WITH daily_steps AS (

    t.amount / 100.0 AS amount,

  FROM transactions t

),

  SELECT
    time,

  FROM daily_steps

),

)

FROM cum_series
UNION ALL

WITH tx_cum AS (
  SELECT
    t.id,
    t.date,
    strftime('%Y-%m-%d', substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(t.date AS TEXT), 7, 2)) AS "Recon Date",
    t.amount / 100.0 AS recon_gain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.notes LIKE '%Reconciliation%' OR t.imported_description LIKE '%Reconciliation%' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.id ASC) / 100.0 AS cum_gain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (t.notes IS NULL OR t.notes NOT LIKE '%Reconciliation%') AND (t.imported_description IS NULL OR t.imported_description NOT LIKE '%Reconciliation%') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.id ASC) / 100.0 AS cum_deposit,

  FROM transactions t

    AND t.tombstone = 0
    AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
)
SELECT
  "Recon Date" AS "Reconciliation Date",

  ROUND(cum_gain, 2) AS "Cumulative Profit ($)",

FROM tx_cum

panels.title: 🔥 Section 8: Financial Independence & Early Retirement (FIRE) Horizon & Multi-Dial Sensitivity Matrices
📖 Plain-English Guide: How Your FIRE Engine, 15-Year Mortgage Bridge & Multi-Dial Matrices Work

options.content:
### 🔥 Why Naive 25x Calculators Overstate Your FIRE Target by ~$800k (The 15-Year Mortgage Bridge)
* **The Naive Trap**: Standard FIRE calculators multiply your current mortgage-inclusive spend (`~$82.1k/yr`) by `25x` (`$2.05M`), assuming you must pay `$38,410/yr` in mortgage Principal & Interest **forever** (`$960k` of portfolio tied up just for the mortgage!).
* **Your Real Trajectory**: Your Rocket Mortgage (`$377.6k` balance at `~5.875%` APR, `$1,400+/mo` principal accelerating monthly) is on a **15-year schedule that naturally hits `$0` in `14.4 years` (`early 2041`)**. At any retirement year $N$, your **True FIRE Target** is simply: **`(Paid-Off Home Annual Spend / SWR) + Remaining Real Mortgage Balance at Year N`**.
* **How to Read the 3 Multi-Dial Tables Below**:
  1. **Dial Matrix 1 (Panel 803 — Years-to-Walk-Away FIRE)**: Cross-tabulates **3 Lifestyle Spend Tiers** (`Core $42.0k/yr`, `All-In CapEx $50.9k/yr`, `Chubby $60.0k/yr`, all including `~$5,121/yr` for unescrowed property tax & insurance) $\times$ **3 Savings Paces** (`All-In $76.2k/yr`, `Market-Only $61.7k/yr`, `1-Income/Half $31.0k/yr`) $\times$ **Real Returns (`5%`, `7%`, `9%`)** $\times$ **Safe Withdrawal Rates (`3.5%`, `4.0%`, `4.5%`)**.
  2. **Dial Matrix 2 (Panel 804 — Work-Horizon Payout Table)**: Shows your exact **Remaining Mortgage**, **Net Mortgage-Free Portfolio**, and **Safe Annual Withdrawal Income** if you choose to work **`+3, +5, +7, +8, +9, +10, +12, or +14.4 years`**.
  3. **Dial Matrix 3 (Panel 805 — Sprint Then Downshift / Coast to 2041)**: Shows what happens if you work full-throttle for **`2 to 6 more years`** and then downshift to **Pure Coast (`$0/yr` saved)**, **Light Barista (`$15k/yr` saved)**, or **1-Income (`$31k/yr` saved)** until your mortgage hits `$0` in `2041`.

WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions WHERE tombstone = 0
),
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT
    a.name,
    a.offbudget,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0
  GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.offbudget
),
port_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 1 AND name NOT IN ('House', 'Mortgage', 'Toyota Tacoma', 'Volkswagen GTI', 'South State Loan [J]', 'Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') AND bal > 0 THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS market_port,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 0 OR name IN ('Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS liquid_cash,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name LIKE '%Brokerage%' OR name LIKE '%Roth%' OR name IN ('Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') OR offbudget = 0 THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS bridge_raw,
    COALESCE(ABS(MIN(CASE WHEN name = 'Mortgage' THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END)), 377563.91) AS mortgage_bal
  FROM acct_bal
),
flows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-89 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0
       AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
       AND (
         (g.name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (t.category IS NULL AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') AND t.amount < 0)
       )
       AND NOT (
         COALESCE(c.name, '') = 'Housing'
         AND (
           COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortgage%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortage%'
           OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Belmont%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Kpm%'
           OR COALESCE(t.imported_description, '') LIKE '%KPM LLC%'
         )
       )
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / 3.0 * 12.0, 0.0) AS annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-364 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Brokerage [J]' AND t.amount < 0
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ttm_brokerage_contrib,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-364 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0 AND c.is_income = 1 AND c.name = 'Income [J]' AND t.amount >= 200000 AND t.transferred_id IS NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 989.07, 0.0) AS ttm_pretax_contrib
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0 AND a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CASE WHEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) > 0 THEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) ELSE 260673.32 END, 2) AS "Investable Portfolio (ex-$35k EF)",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN (port_summary.bridge_raw - 35000.0) > 0 THEN (port_summary.bridge_raw - 35000.0) ELSE 128651.50 END, 2) AS "Penalty-Free Bridge (Brokerage+Roth+HYSA)",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN port_summary.mortgage_bal > 0 THEN port_summary.mortgage_bal ELSE 377563.91 END, 2) AS "Remaining 15-Yr Mortgage (Ends 2041)",
  ROUND(MAX(61715.82, flows.ttm_brokerage_contrib + flows.ttm_pretax_contrib), 2) AS "Market Invest Pace ($/yr)",
  ROUND(MAX(76152.00, flows.ttm_brokerage_contrib + flows.ttm_pretax_contrib + 14436.18), 2) AS "All-In Liquid Pace ($/yr)",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg > 0 THEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg + 5120.52 ELSE 41975.64 END, 2) AS "Paid-Off Home Core Need (w/ Tax+Ins)"
FROM port_summary, flows

panels.description:
Plain English: Multi-combination sensitivity grid showing exact Years to Walk-Away FIRE (when your portfolio can pay off the remaining 15-year mortgage in full AND fund your Paid-Off Home Lifestyle forever) across 81 combinations of:
- 3 Lifestyle Tiers (Core $42.0k/yr, All-In CapEx $50.9k/yr, Chubby $60.0k/yr — all including ~$5.1k/yr unescrowed property tax & insurance)

WITH RECURSIVE
anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions WHERE tombstone = 0
),
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT
    a.name,
    a.offbudget,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0
  GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.offbudget
),
port_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 1 AND name NOT IN ('House', 'Mortgage', 'Toyota Tacoma', 'Volkswagen GTI', 'South State Loan [J]', 'Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') AND bal > 0 THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS market_port,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 0 OR name IN ('Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS liquid_cash,
    COALESCE(ABS(MIN(CASE WHEN name = 'Mortgage' THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END)), 377563.91) AS mortgage_bal
  FROM acct_bal
),
flows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-89 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0
       AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
       AND (
         (g.name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (t.category IS NULL AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') AND t.amount < 0)
       )
       AND NOT (
         COALESCE(c.name, '') = 'Housing'
         AND (
           COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortgage%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortage%'
           OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Belmont%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Kpm%'
           OR COALESCE(t.imported_description, '') LIKE '%KPM LLC%'
         )
       )
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / 3.0 * 12.0, 0.0) AS annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-364 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0 AND g.name = 'One-Time' AND c.name NOT IN ('Truck', 'House Purchase', 'Ring [J]')
       AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ttm_onetime_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Truck' AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS truck_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Ring [J]' AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ring_net
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0 AND a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) > 0 THEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) ELSE 260673.32 END AS p0,
    CASE WHEN port_summary.mortgage_bal > 0 THEN port_summary.mortgage_bal ELSE 377563.91 END AS m0,
    CASE WHEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg > 0 THEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg + 5120.52 ELSE 41975.64 END AS s_core,
    CASE WHEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg > 0 THEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg + flows.ttm_onetime_net + (flows.truck_net / 7.0) + (flows.ring_net / 10.0) + 5120.52 ELSE 50930.64 END AS s_capex,
    60000.0 AS s_chubby
  FROM port_summary, flows
),
scenarios(ord, tier_label, spend_yr, pace_label, contrib_yr) AS (
  SELECT 1, '1. Core Lifestyle ($42.0k/yr w/ Tax+Ins)', s_core, 'All-In ($76.2k/yr)', 76152.00 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, '1. Core Lifestyle ($42.0k/yr w/ Tax+Ins)', s_core, 'Market-Only ($61.7k/yr)', 61715.82 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, '1. Core Lifestyle ($42.0k/yr w/ Tax+Ins)', s_core, '1-Income / Half ($31.0k/yr)', 31000.00 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, '2. All-In CapEx ($50.9k/yr w/ Truck+Travel)', s_capex, 'All-In ($76.2k/yr)', 76152.00 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, '2. All-In CapEx ($50.9k/yr w/ Truck+Travel)', s_capex, 'Market-Only ($61.7k/yr)', 61715.82 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, '2. All-In CapEx ($50.9k/yr w/ Truck+Travel)', s_capex, '1-Income / Half ($31.0k/yr)', 31000.00 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 7, '3. Chubby FIRE ($60.0k/yr Abundance)', s_chubby, 'All-In ($76.2k/yr)', 76152.00 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 8, '3. Chubby FIRE ($60.0k/yr Abundance)', s_chubby, 'Market-Only ($61.7k/yr)', 61715.82 FROM params UNION ALL
  SELECT 9, '3. Chubby FIRE ($60.0k/yr Abundance)', s_chubby, '1-Income / Half ($31.0k/yr)', 31000.00 FROM params
),
sim(ord, m, p5, p7, p9, nom_mtg, real_disc, spend_yr, contrib_yr) AS (
  SELECT s.ord, 0, p.p0, p.p0, p.p0, p.m0, 1.0, s.spend_yr, s.contrib_yr
  FROM scenarios s CROSS JOIN params p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ord, m + 1,
    p5 * (1.0 + 0.048889 / 12.0) + contrib_yr / 12.0,
    p7 * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + contrib_yr / 12.0,
    p9 * (1.0 + 0.086527 / 12.0) + contrib_yr / 12.0,
    MAX(0.0, nom_mtg - (3200.85 - nom_mtg * (0.05875 / 12.0))),
    real_disc * (1.0 + 0.029595 / 12.0),
    spend_yr, contrib_yr
  FROM sim
  WHERE m < 300
),
crossovers AS (
  SELECT
    ord,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p5 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.035 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r5_s35,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p5 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.040 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r5_s40,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p5 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.045 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r5_s45,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p7 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.035 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r7_s35,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p7 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.040 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r7_s40,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p7 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.045 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r7_s45,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p9 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.035 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r9_s35,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p9 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.040 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r9_s40,
    MIN(CASE WHEN (p9 - nom_mtg/real_disc) >= spend_yr/0.045 THEN m END) / 12.0 AS y_r9_s45
  FROM sim
  GROUP BY ord
)
SELECT
  s.tier_label AS "Lifestyle Spend Tier (Paid-Off Home)",
  s.pace_label AS "Savings Pace Dial",
  printf('%.1fy | %.1fy | %.1fy', c.y_r5_s35, c.y_r5_s40, c.y_r5_s45) AS "5% Real (3.5% | 4.0% | 4.5% SWR)",
  printf('%.1fy (%d)', c.y_r7_s35, CAST(2026.8 + c.y_r7_s35 AS INT)) AS "7% Real @ 3.5% SWR",
  printf('%.1fy (%d)', c.y_r7_s40, CAST(2026.8 + c.y_r7_s40 AS INT)) AS "7% Real @ 4.0% SWR (Baseline)",
  printf('%.1fy (%d)', c.y_r7_s45, CAST(2026.8 + c.y_r7_s45 AS INT)) AS "7% Real @ 4.5% SWR",
  printf('%.1fy | %.1fy | %.1fy', c.y_r9_s35, c.y_r9_s40, c.y_r9_s45) AS "9% Real (3.5% | 4.0% | 4.5% SWR)"
FROM scenarios s
JOIN crossovers c ON s.ord = c.ord
ORDER BY s.ord ASC

WITH RECURSIVE
anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions WHERE tombstone = 0
),
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT
    a.name,
    a.offbudget,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0
  GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.offbudget
),
port_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 1 AND name NOT IN ('House', 'Mortgage', 'Toyota Tacoma', 'Volkswagen GTI', 'South State Loan [J]', 'Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') AND bal > 0 THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS market_port,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 0 OR name IN ('Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS liquid_cash,
    COALESCE(ABS(MIN(CASE WHEN name = 'Mortgage' THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END)), 377563.91) AS mortgage_bal
  FROM acct_bal
),
flows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-89 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0
       AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
       AND (
         (g.name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (t.category IS NULL AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') AND t.amount < 0)
       )
       AND NOT (
         COALESCE(c.name, '') = 'Housing'
         AND (
           COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortgage%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortage%'
           OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Belmont%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Kpm%'
           OR COALESCE(t.imported_description, '') LIKE '%KPM LLC%'
         )
       )
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / 3.0 * 12.0, 0.0) AS annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-364 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0 AND g.name = 'One-Time' AND c.name NOT IN ('Truck', 'House Purchase', 'Ring [J]')
       AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '')
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ttm_onetime_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Truck' AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS truck_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Ring [J]' AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS ring_net
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.acct = a.id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.id
  LEFT JOIN category_groups g ON c.cat_group = g.id
  LEFT JOIN payees p ON t.description = p.id
  WHERE t.tombstone = 0 AND a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) > 0 THEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) ELSE 260673.32 END AS p0,
    CASE WHEN port_summary.mortgage_bal > 0 THEN port_summary.mortgage_bal ELSE 377563.91 END AS m0,
    CASE WHEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg > 0 THEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg + 5120.52 ELSE 41975.64 END AS s_core,
    CASE WHEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg > 0 THEN flows.annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg + flows.ttm_onetime_net + (flows.truck_net / 7.0) + (flows.ring_net / 10.0) + 5120.52 ELSE 50930.64 END AS s_capex,
    76152.00 AS c_all
  FROM port_summary, flows
),
sim(m, p5, p7, p9, nom_mtg, real_mtg_disc) AS (
  SELECT 0, p0, p0, p0, m0, 1.0 FROM params
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m + 1,
    p5 * (1.0 + 0.048889 / 12.0) + (SELECT c_all FROM params)/12.0,
    p7 * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + (SELECT c_all FROM params)/12.0,
    p9 * (1.0 + 0.086527 / 12.0) + (SELECT c_all FROM params)/12.0,
    MAX(0.0, nom_mtg - (3200.85 - nom_mtg * (0.05875 / 12.0))),
    real_mtg_disc * (1.0 + 0.029595 / 12.0)
  FROM sim
  WHERE m < 180
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN m = 173 THEN '+14.4 yrs (2041 Mtg=0)' ELSE printf('+%d.0 yrs (%d)', m/12, 2027 + m/12) END AS "Work Horizon",
  ROUND(nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc, 0) AS "Rem. Mortgage (Real $)",
  printf('$%.0fk -> $%.1fk/yr', (p5 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))/1000.0, ((p5 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "5% Real (4% SWR)",
  ROUND(p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc), 0) AS "7% Real Net Portfolio ($)",
  printf('$%.1fk | $%.1fk | $%.1fk', ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.035)/1000.0, ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.04)/1000.0, ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.045)/1000.0) AS "7% Real Safe Spend (3.5% | 4.0% | 4.5%)",
  printf('$%.0fk -> $%.1fk/yr', (p9 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))/1000.0, ((p9 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "9% Real (4% SWR)",
  CASE
    WHEN (p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04 >= 75000 THEN '🚀 FAT FIRE ($75k+/yr)'
    WHEN (p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04 >= 60000 THEN '🟢 CHUBBY FIRE ($60k+/yr)'
    WHEN (p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04 >= (SELECT s_capex FROM params) THEN '🟢 FULL CAPEX FIRE ($50.9k/yr)'
    WHEN (p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04 >= (SELECT s_core FROM params) THEN '🟢 CORE FIRE ($42.0k/yr)'
    WHEN (p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.045 >= (SELECT s_core FROM params) - 5120.52 THEN '🟢 LEAN FIRE (4.5% SWR)'
    WHEN m >= 60 THEN '🟡 BARISTA / 1-PARTNER FIRE'
    ELSE '🟡 COAST FIRE UNLOCKED'
  END AS "Unlocked Tier (@ 7% Real)"
FROM sim
WHERE m IN (36, 60, 84, 96, 108, 120, 144, 173)
ORDER BY m ASC

    p7 * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + (SELECT c_all FROM params)/12.0,
    p9 * (1.0 + 0.086527 / 12.0) + (SELECT c_all FROM params)/12.0,
    MAX(0.0, nom_mtg - (3200.85 - nom_mtg * (0.05875 / 12.0))),
    real_mtg_disc * (1.0 + 0.029595 / 12.0)
  FROM sim
  WHERE m < 180
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN m = 173 THEN '+14.4 yrs (2041 Mtg=0)' ELSE printf('+%d.0 yrs (%d)', m/12, 2027 + m/12) END AS "Work Horizon",
  ROUND(nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc, 0) AS "Rem. Mortgage (Real $)",
  printf('$%.0fk -> $%.1fk/yr', (p5 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))/1000.0, ((p5 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc)) * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "5% Real (4% SWR)",

  printf('$%.1fk | $%.1fk | $%.1fk', ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.035)/1000.0, ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.04)/1000.0, ((p7 - (nom_mtg / real_mtg_disc))*0.045)/1000.0) AS "7% Real Safe Spend (3.5% | 4.0% | 4.5%)",

ORDER BY m ASC

panels.description:
Plain English: Shows what your 2041 mortgage-free portfolio and 4% SWR annual income will be if you work full-throttle ($76.2k/yr saved) for 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 years and then downshift to:
- Option A: Pure Coast ($0/yr saved until 2041 — just cover current bills)
- Option B: Light Barista ($15k/yr saved until 2041)
- Option C: 1-Income / Half-Pace ($31k/yr saved until 2041).

WITH RECURSIVE
anchor AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    date(substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(CAST(MAX(date) AS TEXT), 7, 2)),
    date('now')
  ) AS max_dt
  FROM transactions WHERE tombstone = 0
),
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT
    a.name,
    a.offbudget,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) / 100.0 AS bal
  FROM accounts a
  LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.acct = a.id AND t.tombstone = 0 AND (t.isParent IS NULL OR t.isParent = 0)
  WHERE a.tombstone = 0 AND a.closed = 0
  GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.offbudget
),
port_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 1 AND name NOT IN ('House', 'Mortgage', 'Toyota Tacoma', 'Volkswagen GTI', 'South State Loan [J]', 'Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') AND bal > 0 THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS market_port,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN offbudget = 0 OR name IN ('Savings Joint', 'South State Checking [J]') THEN bal ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS liquid_cash
  FROM acct_bal
),
flows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-89 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0
       AND (c.is_income = 0 OR c.is_income IS NULL)
       AND (
         (g.name IN ('Expected', 'Fun') AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = ''))
         OR (t.category IS NULL AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') AND t.amount < 0)
       )
       AND NOT (
         COALESCE(c.name, '') = 'Housing'
         AND (
           COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortgage%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Mortage%'
           OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Belmont%' OR COALESCE(p.name, '') LIKE '%Kpm%'
           OR COALESCE(t.imported_description, '') LIKE '%KPM LLC%'
         )
       )
      THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / 3.0 * 12.0, 0.0) AS annual_lifestyle_excl_mtg,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.date >= CAST(strftime('%Y%m%d', date((SELECT max_dt FROM anchor), '-364 day')) AS INTEGER)
       AND a.offbudget = 0 AND g.name = 'One-Time' AND c.name NOT IN ('Truck', 'House Purchase', 'Ring [J]')

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.offbudget = 0 AND c.name = 'Truck' AND t.transferred_id IS NULL AND (p.transfer_acct IS NULL OR p.transfer_acct = '') THEN -t.amount / 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS truck_net,

  FROM transactions t

    CASE WHEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) > 0 THEN (port_summary.market_port + port_summary.liquid_cash - 35000.0) ELSE 260673.32 END AS p0,

  SELECT s.sprint_yrs, 0, p.p0, p.p0, p.p0
  FROM sprints s CROSS JOIN params p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sprint_yrs,
    m + 1,
    p_coast * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + (CASE WHEN m < sprint_yrs * 12 THEN 76152.00 ELSE 0.0 END) / 12.0,
    p_barista * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + (CASE WHEN m < sprint_yrs * 12 THEN 76152.00 ELSE 15000.00 END) / 12.0,
    p_half * (1.0 + 0.067849 / 12.0) + (CASE WHEN m < sprint_yrs * 12 THEN 76152.00 ELSE 31000.00 END) / 12.0
  FROM sim_sprint
  WHERE m < 173

  FROM sim_sprint
  WHERE m = sprint_yrs * 12
),
at_2041 AS (
  SELECT sprint_yrs, p_coast, p_barista, p_half
  FROM sim_sprint
  WHERE m = 173
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a.sprint_yrs = 0 THEN '0 yrs (Stop Today)' ELSE printf('Sprint %d yrs (to %d)', a.sprint_yrs, 2027 + a.sprint_yrs) END AS "Sprint Duration",
  ROUND(e.port_at_stop, 0) AS "Port at Downshift ($)",
  printf('$%.2fM -> $%.1fk/yr', a.p_coast/1000000.0, (a.p_coast * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "Coast ($0/yr to 2041)",
  printf('$%.2fM -> $%.1fk/yr', a.p_barista/1000000.0, (a.p_barista * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "Barista ($15k/yr to 2041)",
  printf('$%.2fM -> $%.1fk/yr', a.p_half/1000000.0, (a.p_half * 0.04)/1000.0) AS "1-Income ($31k/yr to 2041)",
  CASE
    WHEN a.p_coast * 0.04 >= 60000 THEN '🚀 CHUBBY ON COAST'

    WHEN a.p_coast * 0.04 >= (SELECT s_core FROM params) THEN '🟢 CORE FIRE ON COAST'
    ELSE '🟡 BARISTA FOR CORE'
  END AS "2041 Status"
FROM at_2041 a
JOIN at_sprint_end e ON a.sprint_yrs = e.sprint_yrs
ORDER BY a.sprint_yrs ASC
